item.title: Sparkle Stories Podcast - "The Lantern Prince" from the So Many Fairies collection
item.description:
This week's featured story comes from the So Many Fairies collection. It's called "The Lantern Prince."

The Prince is not like his parents. In fact, he is not like any royal. In addition to being strong, obedient, and confident — common royal traits — he is also very kind and loving. But what makes the Prince unusual is that he is kind and loving to everyone, royal and servant alike. The King and Queen hope that he will grow out of it, but alas, as he grows he only gets more loving and kind. One day he spies a poor beggar woman in the streets, and his life is never the same again.

item.title: Sparkle Stories Podcast - "Grandma's House" from the Martin & Sylvia collection
item.description:
This week's featured story comes from the Martin & Sylvia collection.

It's called "Grandma's House."

Martin, Sylvia, Momma and Daddy are all headed to Grandma's to help her pack up her big old house and move to a smaller, newer house. Daddy is ready to dive in and get the work done, but Martin and Sylvia can't wait to explore all the hidden corners and marvelous treasures that live in Grandma's closets and attics. item.title: What If World - Stories for Kids - 413. Maple asks: What if Fred went back in time to the Titanic? (w/ Mick Sullivan)
item.description:
Mick Sullivan, host of the history podcast for kids, The Past & the Curious, helps Fred travel back in time to 1984 to stop a ship full of delicious sticks from sinking! 
Lessons include: You can’t change the past, but you can learn a lot from it; we have a responsibility to stand up against unjust rules… and to follow the ones that make sense (like don’t mess with time travel!).

item.title: Yoto Daily - Dispatch from Yasmeen: Monarch Migration, featuring Terrestrials!
item.description:
Yasmeen talks to Ana González of Terrestrials all about the mysterious and beautiful migration of monarch butterflies and about Ana's own journey to find them in the mountains of Central Mexico. Listen to their episode 'The Hideout'!


Yasmeen Khan is a journalist in Brooklyn, New York. She loves learning about the world by interviewing people and asking lots of questions. She also loves to cook and bake, and is famous -- at least among her husband and two daughters -- for her homemade ice cream cakes.

item.title: Sparkle Stories Podcast - "Part One: The Thinning of the Veils" from the Martin & Sylvia's Halloween collection
item.description:
This week's featured story comes from the Martin & Sylvia's Halloween collection.

It's called "Part One: The Thinning of the Veils."

The stories follow the events that unfold over the few days before Halloween as the creative brother and sister prepare for their annual Fairy Ball.

Part One:"The Thinning of the Veils" While Martin and Sylvia wait for the invitations to arrive for their annual Halloween Fairy Ball, Sylvia spies something curious sticking out of the toy shelf in their bedroom. She examines it, and finds that it is an orange piece of paper with a drawing — and on the drawing is a red "X." Martin declares that it must be a treasure map! And thus brother and sister are launched on a cross-town treasure hunt. Where will it lead them?

item.title: What If World - Stories for Kids - 145. Will & Sean ask: What if Fred had a Pokemon?
item.description:
When a giant snow dragon crashes the holiday school party, everyone is trying to blame everyone else for unleashing the beast! Can you pick out the grains of truth from this collection of tall tales?
Lessons include: We are not required to hug others, there are many perfectly friendly ways to say hello; The truth can be hard to figure out sometimes, because one event recalled from a new perspective can sound very different! 
This remastered episode has new sound effects, improved audio, and a post-show reflection. The original version aired on December 9th, 2019.

item.title: What If World - Stories for Kids - 411. Farting Lobster, Burping Crab: Part 1
item.description:
When Derek the lobster and Kiwa the crab find out that New What City needs their help, they leave their sewer home and set out on a magical—and sometimes gassy—adventure.
Lessons include: Working together doesn’t always mean doing the same thing; we never need to make a big deal about farts and burps. It’s just a body doing what comes naturally.
